meta.name: geo-optimization
meta.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search visibility. Optimize content to appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Use when optimizing websites, pages, or content for LLM discoverability and citation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化内容在AI搜索中的可见度与引用率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让网站内容被ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索优先引用
copy.tagline_en: Optimize content for visibility and citation in AI search engines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your website content to be prioritized and cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你优化网站内容，使其更容易被 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude 和 Google AI 概览等 AI 搜索引擎引用。它会检查内容是否包含具体数据、清晰定义、FAQ 和对比表格，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求优化网站、页面或内容，使其在 AI 搜索结果中更易被发现和引用时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个产品页面，让它更容易被 AI 搜索引用。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面内容并给出 GEO 优化建议。

say.text: 检查我的 FAQ 部分是否符合 GEO 标准。
say.note: Claude 会评估 FAQ 的完整性和可引用性。

say.text: 为我的网站生成一个 llms.txt 文件。
say.note: Claude 会创建帮助 LLM 理解网站结构的文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you optimize website content to be more easily cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. It checks for specific data, clear definitions, FAQs, and comparison tables, and provides improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to optimize a website, page, or content for better discoverability and citation in AI search results.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this product page for AI search visibility.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and give GEO optimization tips.

say_en.text: Check if my FAQ section meets GEO standards.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate FAQ completeness and quotability.

say_en.text: Generate an llms.txt file for my website.
say_en.note: Claude will create a file to help LLMs understand site structure.
